I'm from Binghamton, NY and my favorite thing to make are Spiedie Sandwiches. Basically chicken/beef/venison/pork marinaed over night, cooked on the grill and when you're done, you make a sandwich with a piece of Italian bread. The best is having a fresh loaf of italian bread, you cut up slices, butter and garlic each side, cover it with tin foil and put it in the oven at 350 for 10 minutes. When it's done, put meat on the bread, roll it up and enjoy! If you ever see Lupo's or Salamida's spiedie marinade, get it! If you have any questions, be sure to ask!

EDIT: Forgot to mention that the meat you use is cut into inch and a half pieces put on skewers when you grill. You'll want to marinate the meat after it's been cut in a Ziploc bag overnight.
